title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
description: First open-weights Chinchilla-optimal model family. LLaMA-13B outperforms GPT-3 (175B) on most benchmarks. Triggered the open-source LLM ecosystem explosion.
authors: Touvron, Lavril, Izacard, Martinet, Lachaux, Lacroix, Rozière, Goyal, Hambro, Azhar, et al.
